result.summary: The landlord's reply 'Please go ahead' (event 012) clearly approves sending a contractor to fit a new handle. Jev rated it routine and an unconditional approval (0.87). I couldn't assign a contractor because none is named on the ticket or by the landlord. Ticket 19 (R/PM044-2) is a duplicate of the same request with identical events, so assigning here too could mean two contractors are sent and two invoices come in. I've told the tenant the landlord has approved and a contractor will be in touch. I've escalated so ops can pick the master ticket and assign one contractor, and placed a 1-day hold.
